digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure; CI workflow; ruff linting
key_entities: PT001 PT006 PT007 PT008 PT012 PT013 PT017 PT021 PT022 PT028
propositions: Tests run without per-test timeout budgets locally (make test, bare pytest) and lack explicit markers, causing undetected hangs and non-zero exits that consume CI time (27 defects in fortnight review)

Ruff PLW1510 (336 findings) and selected PT codes (481 total findings across 11 codes) are not enabled in [tool.ruff.lint].select, leaving subprocess safety and pytest idiom violations uncaught by make lint

The pytest-timeout ini keys (timeout, timeout_method, timeout_func_only) are absent from [tool.pytest.ini_options] despite pytest-timeout==2.4.0 being pinned, so local test runs use no budget while CI sets --timeout=300 at two steps
Hygiene scripts check_wall_clock_asserts.py and check_raw_git_writes.py run in CI only and are not invoked by make lint, creating drift between local and CI verification

Integration-tier tests exceed a 20s per-test budget when measured with the unit tier; test_timeout_budget.py must be added to validate both a slow test marked with override and a negative arm asserting timeout failure

Existing ruff ratchet and CI parity guard tests must remain passing: [tool.ruff.lint].ignore must stay exactly ["RUF001","RUF002","RUF003"], and all 13 CI pytest lanes must keep --timeout= and --timeout-method=thread flags
